text:
maya: quick alert — us-west warm-pool stalled during morning onboarding after egress default-deny. warm nodes stuck ~35%, seeing keystore decrypt 403 and audit-shipper 403s.

ali: copying in infra. do we have a privatelink CIDR blocked?

neha: sample error: `2026-03-22T06:58:03Z WARN keystore: decrypt failed status=403 caller=redwood-warmpool-role`

sre-oncall: confirmed in staging. firewall denied traffic to keystore privatelink 10.200.5.0/24 due to new deny-by-default. conntrack shows RST.

maya: impact — autoscaler fell back to on-demand; estimated extra cost ~$1.1k over 3h.

ali: immediate plan: create a short-lived egress exception for warmpool tag to 10.200.5.0/24 and SIEM hosts on 443 (TTL 2h). annotate with compliance ticket CMP-882.

neha: also noticed KMS key policy rotation yesterday (iam-team#1729) didn't include new role ARN. updating key policy to add `redwood-warmpool-role`.

sre-oncall: applying terraform change now. ```hcl
resource "firewall_rule" "tmp-warmpool-keystore-allow" {
  name = "tmp-warmpool-keystore-allow"
  src_tags = ["warmpool"]
  dest_cidr_blocks = ["10.200.5.0/24"]
  ports = [443]
  ttl = 7200
}
```

(5m)

sre-oncall: applied. nodes reattempting join.

(10m)

jordan: warm-pool back to ~95%. a couple nodes hit legacy logs domain, adding logs-legacy.partner:443 to exception.

neha: KMS policy updated; decrypts succeeding: `INFO keystore: decrypt ok key=alias/redwood-warmpool caller=redwood-warmpool-role`.

maya: leave exception for 1h for observation then revoke. create postmortem with security to update rollout checklist and add keystore smoke-check in firewall test-suite.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-092 created (severity: low).

sre-oncall: removing temporary rule now. done.

maya: warm-pool stable at 99%. follow-ups: INFRA-451 (KMS pipeline check), CMP-882, add keystore CIDR to firewall tests, add keystore decrypt smoke-check during egress rollouts.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-092 resolved. duration 2h16m.

maya: closing.
